description.p: A native GTK4/libadwaita logbook for radio amateurs. Fast entry row with live worked-before and duplicate indication, searchable QSO table with inline editing, ADIF import/export with lossless round-trip, and contests as first-class log sections with exchange templates, serial numbers and Cabrillo export.

Built to work with its sibling apps: pre-fills frequency and mode from the live VFO of sdr-for-linux over TCI (including CW contest messaging with Run/S&P F-key banks), auto-logs WSJT-X QSOs over UDP with worked-before highlighting, and answers duplicate lookups for skimmer-for-linux. The store is a single SQLite file; the logbook never transmits except operator-triggered CW macros.

Contest presets for WAE DX, CVA DX and SARTG WW RTTY; country resolution from cty.dat with per-contest QSO validity — EU–DX and EU-only scoring, zero-point own country — shown live in the verdict line and served to skimmer-for-linux as INV; worked-B4 and dup checks scoped to the active contest; ADIF export covers only the open log, no more whole-store dumps. Live-verified in the WAE DX Contest CW 2026 — the log went through the DARC robot.

First release: entry row with worked-B4/dup verdicts, QSO table with search and inline edit, ADIF import/export, TCI prefill from sdr-for-linux with CW macro messaging (Run/S&P banks, ESM, cut numbers), WSJT-X UDP auto-logging, contest sections with exchange templates and serials, Cabrillo export, and the duplicate lookup service for skimmer-for-linux. Live-verified in the EUHF Challenge 2026.
